reconciliation_proposals.observation: The shape default has section_break 6; GarmentArmorDesign::new(Tassets) selects the ordinary nonwrapped shape with four lames. nonfindings: Zero section_break explicitly means unsplit and is valid when the parent count is valid; a blanket nonzero rule would change this behavior.
After the selected low-level parent validation, lame_count is 1–12 for Tassets before course divisions; that does not certify GPU geometry or buffer contents.
The selected creator supplies left/right fits and statuses in matching order; no selected-path side swap is established.
A valid standalone shape default need not be valid with every independently selected parent count; the ordinary Tassets default is not itself a wrapped default.
